summary: Phase 1 tested on backend and frontend. Backend: 17/17 new pytest cases pass, plus 24/24 regression cases from iterations 18 and 20. All 7 requested features work end to end: gift removed (POST /api/gifts returns 410, no Gifts nav in Shop or Master, /gift route unmatched, no gift text in home/profile/side menu), 120s quote lock, GST taken out of grams (1450 -> 1406.5 / 43.5; 0.1g pays rate*0.1 and gets 0.097g), ₹500 minimum (buy, silver buy, SIP, with frontend toasts), Master Security & Controls (global rates off hides prices and disables buying; per-shop booking off blocks only Patel; min_investment change is reflected), redeem-grams flow (min 1g error, 409 for a second open request, Shop pop-up with wallet ID, name, mobile, grams and balance, ✕ close, Accept gives an OTP toast and a pickup in Redemptions, Decline cancels), and the referral reward setting (panel + API + public GET). Main gaps: when rates are hidden, product prices and live_rate still leak through /api/products; SIP installments still add GST on top instead of taking it out of grams; the app's referral screen hardcodes ₹50 and ignores the shop setting; SIP preset ₹100 and the 'from ₹100' / 'from just ₹10' copy conflict with the ₹500 minimum.

critical.issue: When Master hides rates (rates_hidden=true), these still return live_rate (e.g. 13848.5), gold_value and total_price, so customers can work out the live rate from the Jewellery tab and home catalogue (home showed ₹1,10,918 etc. while rates were hidden). price_payload is the only place that checks controls_for(). Reference: server.py:750-790. GET /api/vault (server.py:947) also values holdings at gold_rate.

SIP installments still add GST on top: grams=amount/rate, total=amount+gst. This conflicts with requirement 3 (GST inclusive, taken out of grams). Expected: total=amount, gst=amount*0.03, grams=(amount-gst)/rate. Reference: server.py:1257-1266

minor.issue: Hardcoded minimum of 1g (Field ge=1). It ignores jeweller.min_redemption_grams, which /api/redeem uses, and does not check KYC status (it is unclear whether other redemption paths require KYC).
When global rates are off, the Master console header also shows 'Gold —/g', so the platform admin can no longer see the market rate. It may be intended, but master should probably always see rates.
The shops map is fully replaced on every PUT, so a client that sends only global fields silently resets every per-shop override. Works with the current panel, which always sends every shop.

ui_bugs.issue: '₹50' is hardcoded everywhere (hero, steps, list rows, share message) and the screen never calls GET /api/referral-reward, so the shop's reward setting is not reflected in the app. Reference: app/referral.tsx:48,67,94,96,139,166

AMOUNTS preset includes ₹100, which is below the ₹500 minimum. Tapping it and Start gives the 'Minimum investment is ₹500' error. Presets should start at price.min_investment. Reference: app/(tabs)/sip.tsx:17

ui_bugs.component: Home SIP promo / referral share text
ui_bugs.issue: The copy 'Save in gold daily from ₹100' (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:61) and 'Buy & save 24K gold from just ₹10' (app/referral.tsx:48) contradicts the ₹500 minimum.
A 'Gifts' filter chip is still shown (FILTERS id 'gift'). This is gift UI left over in the customer app. Reference: app/(tabs)/vault.tsx:25

ui_bugs.component: BuyWidget when booking is off but rates are visible
ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'LAST 24K BUY RATE' and 'Showing last live rate' even though the rate is live; only booking is off. The label should stay LIVE and the note should say booking is paused. Reference: BuyWidget.tsx:100-102

ui_bugs.component: Header rate pill when rates are hidden
ui_bugs.issue: Shows '24K — ▲ INDICATIVE' with a green dot and up arrow. When hidden it should show a neutral 'Rates not available'.

integration_issues.issue: The quote is locked when the widget mounts and auto-relocks every 2 minutes, not when the customer taps Proceed. If the customer proceeds with a few seconds left, the quote (and rate) changes while the Confirm sheet is open. Lock a fresh quote in proceedToBuy() so the customer gets a full 2:00 freeze on the confirm sheet.
After Accept, the Redemptions nav badge stays stale (showed 1 while the list had 2) because loadDash() is not called after the action. Reference: jeweller_admin.html:453

action_items: HIGH: When controls_for(jid).rates is false, hide prices in /api/products and /api/products/{id} (live_rate, gold_value, total_price set to 0 or null) and in /api/vault current value. In the app, show '—' for product prices.
HIGH: Make SIP installments GST-inclusive like buy(): total=amount, gst=r2(amount*0.03), grams=r4((amount-gst)/rate).
HIGH: Referral screen: fetch GET /api/referral-reward?tenant=<tenant> and use that amount instead of the hardcoded ₹50 (hero, steps, rows, share message).
MEDIUM: SIP presets: drop ₹100 (start at min_investment from /api/price). Update the 'from ₹100' and 'from just ₹10' copy to use min_investment.
MEDIUM: Re-lock the quote when Proceed is tapped so the 2-minute freeze starts at checkout.

LOW: Remove the 'Gifts' passbook filter in vault.tsx. Fix the BuyWidget label for booking-off with live rates. Show a neutral header pill when rates are hidden. Refresh the dashboard badge after redeem Accept/Decline.
Consider: showing the pickup OTP to shop staff in the Accept toast defeats its purpose of verifying the customer at the counter. Only the customer app should show the OTP.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3314 lines and should be split into routers (controls, redeem-requests, referral, studio).
The dead code after `raise HTTPException(410)` in send_gift (server.py:1286+) should be removed.
CONTROLS is held in memory and saved to app_settings. This is fine with --workers 1, but it will not sync across multiple workers or pods in production.
rr_act accept reduces invested by the average cost. That is fine, but the redemption txn amount uses the current rate while total=0. Check this is consistent with the admin reports.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the requested Phase 1 API checks pass (17/17 + 24/24 regression); 2 related backend gaps found (products leak, SIP GST)
success_rate.frontend: ~88% (all requested flows work; referral amount not wired, SIP preset/copy issues)

seed_data_creation: Meera (9834567892): bought 1.2g (mock) + ₹500 gold. 2 of her 1g redeem requests were accepted (2 pending pickups in Sharma Redemptions) and 1 was declined. Aarav's pre-existing 1g request is still pending (it was only closed with ✕ in the panel). All controls restored to on with min 500, no shop overrides. Referral reward restored to 50.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_iteration21_phase1.py. Its test_redeem_flow tops up Meera if her balance is below 2g. The quote/confirm sheet is an RN Modal with a slide animation, so wait about 1.5s before clicking confirm-buy-button (or use dispatch_event('click')). Shop panel login: #le/#lp/#login-btn. Master login: #lu/#lp/#login-btn. Nav buttons are [data-tab=...]. Security controls: #g_rates/#g_booking/#g_min/#ctl-save, per shop #r_<id>/#b_<id>.
rca_of_issue: Products leak: list_products/get_product compute prices with gold_rate() directly and never check controls_for().rates. SIP GST: run_sip was not updated when buy() moved to GST-inclusive pricing. Referral: the frontend was never wired to the new /api/referral-reward endpoint.
